method: Source-diff review of src/routes/links/+page.svelte, the only changed file under this surface. Adds one visitor-facing row, 'Book event coverage', first in the 'More to explore' list, linking to /photography/coverage (served by the main ninochavez.co site, so it carries data-sveltekit-reload to force a full navigation, matching the header/footer links in navigation-contract.test.ts). Label follows reader-contract.json: it names the visitor's next action plainly with no implementation language. Also replaces the deprecated base import with resolve('/') for the existing All galleries row (same destination). A live 390px walk of /photography/links follows the deploy; no local data render was possible from this session.
